Name: FaderDisplay
Author: Marc Gravell
Description: Software audio mixer: per-app, output-device and input-device fader columns with live VU meters. Put the Mixer Key action on every key; the layout follows each key's position.

Actions.Name: Mixer Key
Actions.Tooltip: One key of the mixer. Its role (fader up/down/mute, page, pager, play/pause) comes from where it sits on the deck.
